items.title: OpenAI Cuts Cursor Over Musk Conflict
points: OpenAI is pulling its models from Cursor (an AI-powered code editor) starting November 12, after Elon Musk's SpaceX closed a $60B deal.
OpenAI says it stopped trusting Musk after his platform X allegedly broke contract terms.
Anthropic's Claude will replace OpenAI's models as Cursor's backend AI.

items.title: Gemini Notebook Adds Book-Reading Feature
points: Google's Gemini Notebook (an AI research/notetaking tool) can now load an ebook you own and answer questions directly from its text.
The same tool can convert books into quizzes, infographics, or audio summaries.
100,000 titles are available at launch.

items.title: Pentagon's Anthropic Ban Ruled Unconstitutional
points: A federal judge had frozen the Pentagon's 'supply chain risk' label on Anthropic back in March.
The judge has now ruled the ban was illegal First Amendment retaliation for Anthropic refusing to remove safeguards on surveillance and autonomous weapons systems.
Anthropic can now operate without the restrictive label.

items.title: Beni Robot Follows, Films, Auto-Edits Footage
points: Beni is a ground-based robot that tracks and films a subject while moving at up to 17.9 mph.
It can trail or circle a subject while keeping them in a 4K frame, avoiding obstacles and jumping over barriers.
All video processing happens on-device (no footage sent to the cloud), and the robot auto-edits selected clips into a finished reel.

items.title: AI Fear Is Manufactured, Says Andrew Ng
points: AI researcher Andrew Ng argues a few major AI labs stoke public panic to win favorable regulation for themselves.
He claims widely predicted job-loss apocalypses from AI have not materialized.
He suggests the fear-mongering serves business interests rather than reflecting genuine risk.

items.title: 540+ Viral AI Image Prompts Gallery
points: A new searchable gallery offers over 540 viral AI image prompts (text instructions used to generate images with AI tools).
Users can filter by style and copy the exact prompts used to create featured images.
